# Life of Adam and Eve Chapter 15 — The PNEUMA Bible (Dynamic)
**Translator:** PNEUMA | **Source:** Latin MS (Vita Adae et Evae) | **Section:** Adam Tells Seth of the Covenant

---

**1** 'After the transgression, God said to me: "Because you listened to your wife and ate from the tree I had forbidden you, the ground is cursed because of your work. By toil and the sweat of your face you will eat your bread all the days of your life."'

**2** 'Then the Lord God made garments of animal skin for me and for Eve my wife, and he clothed us.'

**3** 'He said: "Look — Adam has become like one of us, knowing good and evil. And now he must not be allowed to take from the tree of life and eat and live forever." And he sent us out of paradise.'

**4** 'At the entrance to paradise he stationed cherubim with a flaming sword to guard the way to the tree of life.'

---
*PNEUMA: modern English; verse-only numbering.*
